resources.string: Revoke Access
Review token and NFT permissions on EVM networks
Find and revoke spending permissions previously granted to exchanges and dapps. Disconnecting a dapp does not revoke its on-chain approvals.
Scans query your selected network provider with your public address. No additional approval indexer is used. When Tor is enabled, scanning waits for Tor to connect.

This tool checks standard ERC-20, ERC-721 and ERC-1155 approvals. It does not invalidate every signed permit or smart-account delegation, disconnect WalletConnect sessions, or recover lost funds. Scan progress is kept only while this screen remains open.
Confirm revoke access

This calls the standard method to clear the selected approval or disable the NFT operator, with no native currency attached. A network fee is required. Verify the network, contract and spender: a malicious or non-standard contract can behave differently.
Checking current permission and estimating the network fee…

The revoke could not be prepared or submitted. The permission or wallet may have changed, Tor may be disconnected, or the network may be unavailable. Return to the list and check again. If a submission was interrupted, check transaction history before retrying.
Transaction submitted
The revoke transaction was submitted, not yet confirmed. Wait for confirmation in transaction history, then scan or check the permission again.
